catalog.name: list_products
catalog.description: A single explicit page of WooCommerce products, ordered by ID. Follow next_page to collect more. Prices are store-currency decimal strings.

catalog.name: create_product
catalog.description: Create one simple product. Defaults to published/visible, decimal price in configured store currency. Require a unique SKU; never automatically retry a timed-out write. Reconcile unknown outcomes by listing that SKU.

catalog.name: list_orders
catalog.description: A single explicit page of orders (ID ascending). Optional UTC second-precision after/before form a half-open interval [after,before). Use Calendar day_range; follow next_page. Omits customer/private metadata.

catalog.name: get_order
catalog.description: Get one order by its positive ID. Money and creation time are exact; customer/private metadata is omitted.

catalog.name: update_order_status
catalog.description: Set one order to a supported WooCommerce status. Status assignment is repeatable but Woo hooks may have effects. Never automatically retry an ambiguous write; reconcile with get_order.

catalog.name: now
catalog.description: Actual current UTC instant and local time in an explicit IANA timezone.

catalog.name: day_range
catalog.description: Half-open UTC bounds [start,end) for a local calendar date (or today). Handles DST; pass bounds to list_orders.

catalog.name: sum_amounts
catalog.description: Exact sum of up to 1000 decimal strings. Never uses floating point; precision must match the declared currency.

catalog.name: sum_orders
catalog.description: Exact sum of unique order IDs from explicitly collected pages. Rejects mixed currencies and duplicates. This is a submitted-data total, not a claim that all orders were fetched.

limitation: Privileged gateway-labelled acceptance fixture; no M3 production gateway or M4 autonomous LLM prompt is claimed.
